proposed_rules.trigger: A stack of single-column [2x1] zones each with an H2/paragraph, heights varying (374-766px), alternating down the page.
proposed_rules.decision: Map each row as its own section with default-content (H2+paragraph). Do not group rows into one repeating block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternative: repeating-cards-are-one-block — rejected because the seven rows vary widely in height and content shape, indicating distinct authored sections.

proposed_rules.trigger: A heading like 'See It in Action' / 'Watch a demo' directly above a large media region with no repeating-card structure.
proposed_rules.decision: Map the heading as default-content and the media region as a dedicated video/embed block, distinct from a plain image block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Video embeds have different authoring needs (embed URL vs asset) than static images; conflating them with the generic image-in-flow rule would lose that distinction.

provenance.evidence: C136 rc2c2 'See It in Action Watch a Knack...'

proposed_rules.trigger: An FAQ accordion whose answer [region] nodes are captured as siblings at coordinates matching a different question row than their own, or promoted to a top-level root sibling (e.g. rc4).
proposed_rules.decision: During Phase 2, re-pair each [region] answer with its nearest preceding question row by reading order rather than trusting coordinate overlap; do not drop the root-level stray [region] node.
proposed_rules.rationale: The overlay-promotion pass in the tree walker appears to have detached/duplicated answer nodes from their question rows, producing coordinate collisions that would corrupt a naive row-by-row pairing.

provenance.evidence: C136 rc2c11c3/c8 both @173,6343; rc2c11c4/c9 both @173,6401; rc4 [region] stray at root

notes: Vertical/solution page with a leaked inline script at the top, a HIPAA-CRM hero, seven alternating feature rows, a filled CTA banner, and an FAQ accordion whose answer nodes were captured out of order relative to their questions.
